name: latex-review-companion
description: PDF preview that follows your cursor (SyncTeX), clickable evidence markers linking every citation in the built PDF to its source PDF, and a bibliography integrity check.

commands.title: LaTeX: Open PDF preview (Simple Browser, sync-safe)
LaTeX Citations: Check citations against bibliography
LaTeX Citations: Enable evidence links (refreshes map)
LaTeX Citations: Toggle evidence PDF server

latexCitations.port.description: Port for the local server that serves source PDFs to the evidence links.

latexCitations.sourcesDirs.description: Directories (relative to the root .tex) searched for <citekey>.pdf source files, in priority order.

latexCitations.markerSymbol.description: LaTeX snippet rendered as the evidence marker after each citation.

latexCitations.markerColor.description: xcolor expression for the evidence marker.

latexCitations.backend.description: Citation package whose \citep/\citet get wrapped with evidence markers. 'auto' detects from the preamble.
